description:
Detects XXE attack patterns in XML request bodies including SYSTEM and PUBLIC external entity declarations

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg07_006", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%xml%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%external%') AND "value" > 0
